Animal Classification

Make a paper-plate craft about your assigned animal group.

Find my worksheet

Make your paper-plate craft

What you’ll need A regular paper plate, A4 paper, scissors and glue.

  1. Find your group

    Search for your name below and tap Download PDF next to it.

  2. Print your sheet

    Open the downloaded PDF and print it on A4 paper.

  3. Cut along the lines

    Cut out the title, pictures, and fact box along the dashed lines. Ask an adult for help if needed.

  4. Arrange and glue

    Arrange the cutouts on one paper plate, then glue them down. Write your name and class on the back.

Bring your finished craft to school on Sunday, 29 November 2026.
